main_route.title: Outer Gate
main_route.story: The gate is powered, but every personnel badge was invalidated at the same second.

main_route.title: Archive Annex
main_route.story: The archive log ends mid-sentence. The final entry repeatedly references Core C and an unknown carrier signal.

main_route.title: Emergency Lift
main_route.story: The auxiliary reactor is failing. The team has one clean route back to the surface.

optional_rooms.title: Emergency Stores
optional_rooms.story: A sealed emergency locker still contains usable medical and ammunition packs.

optional_rooms.title: Signal Lab
optional_rooms.story: A local recorder captured the carrier signal before the blackout. The waveform appears to respond to human movement.
